d: Anthropic, the company behind the Claude AI chatbot, is preparing to go public with a proposed valuation of over $1.4 trillion. Strong investor demand could push that figure even higher, something around $1.5 trillion. The company is seeing rapid growth, with major businesses using its AI tools and billions of dollars in revenue. But there's another side to the story. Anthropic has committed around $900 billion to computing power and infrastructure, while still reporting quarterly operating losses. So, what makes investors so bullish? And can Anthropic turn the AI boom into a profitable…
